note: Attacker gains only. DESERIALIZE was removed in rev 2: it is a primitive (mechanism step), not an effect — a deserialization record claims the effect it yields (usually EXEC).

effects.EXEC: Attacker-chosen command runs on the host (shell or argv semantics — see sink.exec.* families).
effects.CODE_EXEC: Attacker-supplied code is evaluated in a runtime/engine context (eval, template, expression language).
effects.FILE_READ: Reads a file outside the intended tree or access scope.
effects.FILE_WRITE: Writes a file outside the intended tree — the RCE-adjacent flavor; prioritise over FILE_READ.
effects.NET_CONNECT: The server makes a request the attacker influenced (SSRF) — to internal services, metadata, or an attacker host.
effects.SQL_EXEC: Attacker-controlled SQL syntax reaches the database parser.
effects.TEMPLATE_EVAL: User input is evaluated by a template engine (subset of CODE_EXEC kept separate for engine fingerprinting).
effects.AUTH_DECISION: An authentication/authorization/validity check returns the wrong answer for the attacker.
effects.MEM_READ: Out-of-bounds or use-after-free read in native code.
effects.MEM_WRITE: Out-of-bounds or use-after-free write in native code.
effects.INFO_LEAK: Secrets, internal state, or errors disclosed beyond intended scope.
effects.LOG_INJECT: Attacker data written into logs in a way that poisons downstream consumers.
